title: wg: protocol-06 selects on a protocol field that doesn't exist
description: Erratum. select (protocol) with no protocol field in scope: FanoutMessage (L1929), KeyMaterial client data (L1259), select (room.protocol) (L1439). GroupInfoResponse/TBS (L2146-2161) declares "Protocol version;" then selects on protocol. Implementations may or may not put a Protocol byte on the wire. mimid takes protocol from context and treats version as the Protocol field (decision mimid-1wgh.5.23). Fix: add explicit fields or name them consistently.
